title.en: An Explanation of Progress in Learning

edition.en: Text as given on Chinese Wikisource (from the Quan Tang wen, book 558), with its interlinear variant notes (一作…) removed; compared with the Dongya tang edition of Han Yu’s collected works (book 12) in the Kanseki Repository, from which 忘己量 is read for the online 忘已量.
edition.zh: 据维基文库（录自《全唐文》卷五百五十八），删去文中“一作某”的异文小注；与京都大学汉籍资料库（Kanseki Repository）所收东雅堂本《昌黎先生集》卷十二对校，维基文库“忘已量”据校本作“忘己量”。

basis.en: Tang dynasty prose, written in 813; the author died in 824.
basis.zh: 唐代散文，作于 813 年，作者卒于 824 年。

note.en: Han Yu was a professor at the National Academy for the third time, passed over and poor, when he wrote this little play: a teacher urges diligence, a student laughs and lists the teacher’s labours and their reward, and the teacher answers by comparing a good state to a carpenter and a physician who find a use for every timber and every root. It is a complaint dressed as a lesson, and the lesson is still the better half. Several of its phrases became proverbs, among them burning the lamp oil to carry on after the sun.
note.zh: 韩愈第三次出任国子博士，仕途不顺，家境清贫，写下了这篇小小的戏剧：先生勉励学生勤学，学生笑着列举先生的种种辛劳和所得的回报，先生则回答说，好的朝廷就像工匠和医师，每根木料、每味药材都派得上用场。这是一篇装扮成教诲的牢骚，而其中的教诲仍是更好的那一半。文中好几句话后来成了成语，比如“焚膏油以继晷”。

excerpt.orig: 業精於勤，荒於嬉；行成於思，毀於隨。
excerpt.en: Learning is perfected by diligence and wasted by play; conduct is formed by thought and spoiled by drifting.
excerpt.zh: 业精于勤，荒于嬉；行成于思，毁于随。

gloss.en: The Master of the National Academy: Han Yu himself, then a professor there.
gloss.zh: 国子先生，韩愈自称，他当时任国子博士。

gloss.at: 業精於勤，荒於嬉；行成於思，毀於隨
gloss.en: 隨 is following along without thought, drifting with others.
gloss.zh: 随，随波逐流，不加思考地跟着别人。
gloss.at_hans: 业精于勤，荒于嬉；行成于思，毁于随

gloss.en: All the instruments of government, laws and institutions, are fully set out.
gloss.zh: 治理国家的各种法令制度都已建立。治具，治国的工具。

gloss.en: Raising up the able and good. 畯 is read as 俊.
gloss.zh: 提拔优秀的人才。畯，同“俊”。

gloss.en: Raking and netting, picking and choosing; scraping off the dirt and polishing to a shine: the court’s care in finding talent.
gloss.zh: 广泛搜罗，精心挑选；刮去污垢，磨出光泽。比喻朝廷选拔、造就人才。

gloss.en: Burning lamp oil to continue the sun; 晷 is the sun’s shadow on a dial, daylight.
gloss.zh: 点燃油灯来接续白天。晷，日影，指白昼。

gloss.en: Always toiling, to the end of every year. 兀兀 is the look of unremitting effort.
gloss.zh: 一年到头勤勤恳恳。兀兀，勤勉不止的样子。

gloss.en: Han Yu was the Tang’s leading opponent of Buddhism and Daoism; in 819 his memorial against honouring a relic of the Buddha cost him his post.
gloss.zh: 韩愈是唐代反对佛教、道教最力的人；819 年他上《谏迎佛骨表》，因此被贬。

gloss.en: Patching the cracks and leaks; bringing out what is dark and subtle.
gloss.zh: 弥补缺漏，阐发精微。苴，鞋垫，引申为填补；罅，裂缝；张皇，张大、发扬。

gloss.en: Turning back the wild wave after it has already broken: became the idiom 力挽狂瀾.
gloss.zh: 把已经倒下的狂澜挽回来。后来演为成语“力挽狂澜”。

gloss.en: Holding the blossoms in the mouth and chewing the flowers: savouring the best of literature.
gloss.zh: 细细品味文章的精华。英、华，都指花。

gloss.en: Above, taking as models the documents of Shun, of the Yao clan, and of Yu, of the Si clan: the oldest parts of the Book of Documents.
gloss.zh: 向上取法虞、夏的典籍。姚，舜的姓；姒，禹的姓。

gloss.en: Knotted and grating on the teeth: hard to read aloud.
gloss.zh: 文句艰涩拗口。

gloss.en: Yang Xiong and Sima Xiangru, the great Han rhapsodists: equal in skill, different in tune.
gloss.zh: 扬雄（字子云）和司马相如，汉代辞赋大家，技巧同样高明而风格各异。成语“异曲同工”出此。

gloss.en: From the Book of Songs: an old wolf that steps on its dewlap going forward and trips on its tail going back.
gloss.zh: 语出《诗经·豳风·狼跋》：老狼往前走踩着自己颈下的垂肉，往后退又被尾巴绊倒。比喻进退两难。

gloss.en: In 803 Han Yu was a censor for a few months and was then banished to Yangshan in the far south for a memorial on famine relief.
gloss.zh: 803 年，韩愈任监察御史仅几个月，就因上书论天旱人饥，被贬为阳山县令。

gloss.en: Head bald as a hill without trees, teeth with gaps.
gloss.zh: 头顶秃了，牙齿缺了。童，山无草木叫童，这里指秃顶。

gloss.en: Brackets, short posts on the beams, door pivots, the post in the middle of a gateway, door bolts and the side posts of a door.
gloss.zh: 欂栌，柱上的斗拱；侏儒，梁上的短柱；椳，门枢；闑，门中间竖的短木；扂，门闩；楔，门两旁的木柱。

gloss.at: 玉劄丹砂，赤箭青芝，牛溲馬勃，敗鼓之皮
gloss.en: Medicines precious and lowly: burnet root and cinnabar, gastrodia and green fungus, plantain and puffball, and the hide of a worn-out drum.
gloss.zh: 贵贱各种药材：玉札（地榆）、丹砂、赤箭（天麻）、青芝，牛溲（车前草）、马勃（一种菌类），以及破鼓皮。
gloss.at_hans: 玉劄丹砂，赤箭青芝，牛溲马勃，败鼓之皮

gloss.at: 訾醫師以昌陽引年，欲進其豨苓也
gloss.en: Calamus was thought to lengthen life; hog-tuber is a cheap diuretic. The point is that the unworthy want the worthy replaced by the commonplace.
gloss.zh: 昌阳，即菖蒲，据说久服可以延年；豨苓，即猪苓，一种普通的利尿药。意思是非难良医，反而推荐平庸之物。
gloss.at_hans: 訾医师以昌阳引年，欲进其豨苓也
